canonical:
glassbox-canonical 1
version 2
id "helm-claim"
title "A name on the Helm hub"
clock seconds
initial "free"
notes 20
  note "One name on the hub: an output such as the Twister, or a responsibility"
  note "such as itajara:switches. The hub keeps one of these machines per name."
  note ""
  note "Who holds the name is NOT a state. The hub behaves the same whoever the"
  note "holder is, so the holder's identity stays in the host, and reaches the"
  note "machine as one fact about each request: was it sent by the holder. That"
  note "is the elevator's lesson about floors, applied to connections."
  note ""
  note "A grant therefore stays in 'held': the holder changes and the mode does"
  note "not. The frames the hub sends in reply (claims, wanted, refused, asked)"
  note "are not in this machine either. Glassbox commands belong to entering and"
  note "leaving a state, and most of the hub's replies happen on a request that"
  note "changes no state. They are pinned by the scenarios in helm-hub.json."
  note ""
  note "What this machine does pin: which requests change whether the name is"
  note "held, which are refused, and why."
  note ""
  note "Written 2026-11-13 from hub/hub.mjs as it stood, as part of the wire"
  note "declarations spike. hub/conformance-machine.mjs drives the real hub"
  note "through every vector generated from this file."
states 2
  state "free" "Free" false (entry 0) (exit 0)
  state "held" "Held" false (entry 0) (exit 0)
events 7
  event "ask" "ask" user
  event "claim" "claim" user
  event "grant" "grant" user
  event "holder-gone" "holder disconnects" runtime
  event "refuse" "refuse" user
  event "release" "release" user
  event "want" "want" user
config 0
facts 2
  fact "by-holder" "The request is from the holder"
  fact "recipient-known" "Exactly one client has the name given in 'to'"
refusals 4
  refusal "held-by-another" "the name is held by another connection"
  refusal "no-such-client" "no one client has that name"
  refusal "nobody-to-ask" "nobody holds the name"
  refusal "not-the-holder" "only the holder can grant a name"
commands 0
rules 14
  rule "free" "ask" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "nobody-to-ask")))
  rule "free" "claim" (cases 1 (case - (move "held")))
  rule "free" "grant" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-the-holder")))
  rule "free" "holder-gone" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "free" "refuse" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "recipient-known")) (stay)) (case - (refuse "no-such-client")))
  rule "free" "release" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "free" "want" (cases 1 (case - (move "held")))
  rule "held" "ask" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "held" "claim" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "by-holder")) (stay)) (case - (refuse "held-by-another")))
  rule "held" "grant" (cases 3 (case (not (holds (fact "by-holder"))) (refuse "not-the-holder")) (case (not (holds (fact "recipient-known"))) (refuse "no-such-client")) (case - (stay)))
  rule "held" "holder-gone" (cases 1 (case - (move "free")))
  rule "held" "refuse" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "recipient-known")) (stay)) (case - (refuse "no-such-client")))
  rule "held" "release" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "by-holder")) (move "free")) (case - (stay)))
  rule "held" "want" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
deadlines 0
